Title: 502430-2026: France – Construction of footbridges – Works for the construction of a cycle and pedestrian footbridge allowing the crossing of the railway tracks
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Highly relevant: pedestrian and cyclist bridge with approx. 25 m span meets sbp criteria (pedestrian bridges and >20 m). Execution with a prefabricated UHPC/BFUP trough and works in an operational railway environment make the project technically interesting, despite its location in France.
titel: Construction of a pedestrian and cyclist bridge to cross the railway tracks
kurzbeschreibung: Pedestrian and cycle bridge over railway tracks with UHPC/BFUP superstructure, lifts and aluminium staircases.
umfang: New construction of a pedestrian and cyclist bridge over the Bordeaux–Hendaye railway line in the immediate vicinity of operational tracks. Main superstructure as a prefabricated UHPC/BFUP element with an approximate span of 25 m. In addition, access staircases made of aluminium, two lifts for barrier-free use and bicycles, steel structures for the lift shafts with glazing, reinforced concrete components such as piers, lift shafts, brackets and ancillary structures, bearings, expansion joints, railings, handrails, protective walls for the overhead line as well as drainage and electrical installations. Installation of the main superstructure over the tracks during track possessions and under railway operating constraints.
leistungen: Construction works including site installation, earthworks, excavation support and dewatering, shallow foundations, production, transport and installation of prefabricated UHPC/BFUP elements, prestressing, reinforced concrete works, metal works, lifts, electrical and lighting installations, drainage and connections, installation of the superstructure over railway tracks, tests, load tests, commissioning and reinstatement of external areas.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Pedestrian and cyclist bridges are generally highly relevant for sbp.
• Technically interesting small bridge structure with prefabricated UHPC/BFUP superstructure and an approximate span of 25 m.
• Additional complexity due to construction under ongoing railway operations with track possessions and close coordination with SNCF Réseau.
• Combination of materials and structural systems using UHPC/BFUP, aluminium and steel indicates an innovative and lightweight structural approach.
• However, this is a prior information notice for construction works, not a specific tender for design services.
• Project size is rather medium to small, therefore limited fee and revenue potential for sbp.
• Strategically still interesting as a potential partner project with contractors or specialist companies.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the notice. For a rough estimate, relevant aspects are: 25 m UHPC/BFUP main superstructure, railway environment with track possessions, two lifts, aluminium staircases, steel-glass lift shafts, reinforced concrete substructures as well as demanding installation over operational tracks. On this basis, a mid single-digit million amount could be conceivable, but without reliable quantity data it would not be serious to state a figure.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee information available. This is a prior information notice for construction works, not for the award of design services. An sbp fee would only be conceivable in the context of a subcontractor or partner role with design involvement, but cannot be reliably quantified from the information provided.
auftraggeber: COMMUNE DE MARCHEPRIME, 3 Avenue de la République, 33380 Marcheprime, France, buyer profile: https://demat-ampa.fr/entreprise
notes: Prior information notice for information purposes only, no current bid deadline. Expected publication of the contract notice on 11/09/2026. Single lot, negotiated procedure envisaged, planned duration 18 months.
